<description>
This fixes an antithesis bug reported https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/35845 and similar bug reported in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/33387 where if asynchronous IPC mining calls are made when the node is shutting down it's possible for `assert(m_node.chainman)` to trigger. This happens because the `Ipc::disconnectIncoming` method does not wait for asynchronous calls to complete after it disconnects IPC clients, so they may continue to run as the node is shutting down.

This PR changes `disconnectIncoming` to wait for asynchronous calls to complete to avoid this issue. It's a draft because it depends on libmultiprocess changes, but should otherwise be ready to review.

**This is based on https://github.com/bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess/pull/335.**
</description>
